integrity_notes: The general rank/ambiguity criterion and the earlier sufficient coprimality condition are credited to their primary sources. scientific_limitations: The rank concerns linear informational completeness on all Hermitian operators, not injectivity restricted to pure states; no claim about noise conditioning, partial phase-space sampling, or arbitrary-shaped windows.
title: Exact operator-span rank and arithmetic thresholds for cyclic boxcar Gabor measurements
